velis-ltd.title: Velis LTD
velis-ltd.summary: Construction company corporate site with product catalog.
body: We designed a corporate website for Velis LTD that reflects over 25 years of industry experience. Built on WordPress with a product catalog, multi-language support, and SEO optimization.
We created a professional digital identity for the construction and manufacturing sector. Responsive design, fast load times, and easy content management strengthened the client's digital presence.

bt-elevator.title: BT Elevator
bt-elevator.summary: Multi-language elevator company website with SEO optimization.
body: We designed and developed the corporate website for BT Elevator, an elevator company based in Eskisehir, Turkey. Multi-language structure, SEO optimization, and modern design created a standout digital presence in the industry.
Technical SEO work, schema markup, and performance optimization targeted top search engine rankings. We delivered a trust-building user experience aligned with the corporate identity.

gel-gez-gor.title: Gel Gez Gor
gel-gez-gor.summary: Free classifieds platform for North Cyprus with multiple categories.
body: We designed and developed Gel Gez Gor, a comprehensive free classifieds platform for North Cyprus. We built a dynamic platform hosting thousands of listings across real estate, vehicles, jobs, and food categories.
With a user-friendly interface, advanced filtering system, and SEO optimization, we helped it become one of the most visited classifieds sites in North Cyprus.

nexos-investment.title: Nexos Investment
nexos-investment.summary: Custom real estate listing & management system built from scratch — maps, i18n, automated PDF/PPT proposals.
body: Off-the-shelf themes couldn't meet Nexos Investment's needs (advanced listing management, map-based display, multi-language, automated proposal generation). We built a scalable listing management system from scratch with Next.js, Supabase and Vercel: an interactive Google Maps + Leaflet clustered map, multi-language via next-intl, and automated PDF/PowerPoint proposal generation from listing data.

An admin panel with TipTap editing and drag-and-drop, PWA/offline support, Zod validation, Upstash rate-limiting and Playwright E2E tests delivered a production-grade platform. The firm now runs maps, proposals and content from one fully-controlled system — the technical peak of our portfolio.

ambalaj-cini.title: Ambalaj Cini
ambalaj-cini.summary: E-commerce + ad management — 30% company growth via Google Ads and Meta campaigns.
body: For Bilecik-based Ambalaj Cini we led development of the Next.js/React online sales platform: payment integration, product management and the order flow in one system.

Alongside development we set up and managed Google Ads and Facebook (Meta) campaigns — these digital growth efforts drove 30% company growth. Concrete, results-driven proof of our ad management service.

avie-global.title: Avie Global
avie-global.summary: Automotive spare parts trading company corporate website.
body: We designed a corporate website for Avie Global Trading in the automotive spare parts trading sector. Built on WordPress, we created a professional platform showcasing the company profile, product range, and business partnerships.
Global trade-focused design, multi-language content structure, and SEO optimization targeted reaching international customers.

alp-sigorta.title: Alp Sigorta
alp-sigorta.summary: Insurance company corporate website with service catalog.
body: We designed a professional, trust-building corporate website for Alp Sigorta that showcases their insurance services. We created a comprehensive digital platform featuring a service catalog, quote request forms, and customer information pages.
Responsive design, fast load times, and SEO optimization ensured potential customers could easily find and reach the company.

pampas-investment.title: Pampas Investment
pampas-investment.summary: Real estate investment company website in North Cyprus.
body: We developed a corporate website focused on real estate investment and sales for Pampas Investment, based in Esentepe, North Cyprus. We built a strong digital presence with a project portfolio, land details, and investor information pages.
SEO optimization, multi-language support, and responsive design helped us reach international investors. Property listing integrations and social media connections boosted client acquisition.

ekh-yapi.title: EKH Yapı
ekh-yapi.summary: Construction company website with project portfolio.
body: We designed a corporate website for EKH Yapı showcasing their construction and contracting services. We established a strong digital identity in the sector through a portfolio of completed and ongoing projects, service details, and references.
A project gallery, contact forms, and mobile-friendly design streamlined client acquisition. The WordPress infrastructure enabled easy content management.

radyo-juke.title: Radyo Juke
radyo-juke.summary: Online radio platform with custom-coded live streaming integration.
body: For Radyo Juke we built the live broadcast not with an off-the-shelf widget but with custom integration code — uninterrupted streaming, a program guide and listener interaction on one platform.
A responsive structure delivers seamless listening on mobile and desktop; social integrations and share flows grew the audience. A concrete example of our custom development capability.

ozge-ozler.title: Özge Özler
body: We designed a professional and elegant portfolio website for Özge Özler that puts her personal brand front and center. A minimalist design approach ensured the content takes the spotlight.
SEO optimization, fast load times, and a mobile-friendly structure established a strong digital presence.

rnv-trading.title: RNV Trading
rnv-trading.summary: Trading and import-export company corporate website.
body: We developed a corporate website for RNV Trading showcasing their international trade and import-export operations. A professional image, product catalog, and partnership details established a strong digital identity.
Multi-language support, SEO optimization, and modern design helped the company reach a global customer base.

pinnacle-yatirim.title: Pinnacle Yatırım
pinnacle-yatirim.summary: Real estate investment company website in North Cyprus.
body: We developed a professional corporate website for Pinnacle Yatırım targeting the North Cyprus real estate investment sector. We created a comprehensive platform showcasing the investment portfolio, project details, and consultancy services.
Modern design, SEO optimization, and a mobile-friendly structure delivered a strong digital experience for potential investors.

jet-transfer-cyprus.title: Jet Transfer Cyprus
jet-transfer-cyprus.summary: Airport transfer and VIP transportation service website.
body: We developed a professional website for Jet Transfer Cyprus offering airport transfer and VIP transportation services. An online booking system, route information, and fare calculators put the user experience first.
Mobile-friendly design, WhatsApp integration, and multi-language support made it easy for both local and international tourists to book services.

boon-fresh.title: Boon Fresh
boon-fresh.summary: Fresh food and grocery delivery e-commerce platform.
body: We developed a fresh food and grocery delivery platform for Boon Fresh. We built a comprehensive e-commerce infrastructure with a product catalog, order management, and delivery tracking.
A user-friendly interface, streamlined ordering flow, and mobile-responsive design prioritized customer satisfaction. SEO optimization drove organic traffic growth.

halas-exchange.title: Halas Exchange
halas-exchange.summary: Currency exchange company website with live rates.
body: We developed a reliable and professional website for Halas Exchange offering currency exchange services. We created a comprehensive platform featuring live exchange rates, branch locations, and corporate information.
Fast load times, responsive design, and SEO optimization ensured customers could reach the company with ease.

arslan-estates.title: Arslan Estates
arslan-estates.summary: Real estate agency website with property listings.
body: We developed a professional real estate website for Arslan Estates featuring property listing management, detailed property pages, and customer communication tools. Modern design and an advanced filtering system improved the buyer experience.
SEO optimization, map integration, and social media connections boosted digital visibility. Multi-language support enabled the company to reach international clients.

arslan-coin-center.title: Arslan Coin Center
arslan-coin-center.summary: Cryptocurrency exchange and trading center website.
body: We developed a modern website for Arslan Coin Center offering cryptocurrency buying, selling, and exchange services. A professional design emphasized trust and transparency.
Service information, location details, and communication tools streamlined client acquisition. SEO and social media integration strengthened the digital presence.

arslan-group.title: Arslan Group
body: We developed a corporate holding website for Arslan Group that presents their real estate, finance, and trading companies under one roof. We created a comprehensive platform professionally showcasing the group structure, business divisions, and corporate vision.
Modern design, multi-language support, and SEO optimization established a strong corporate digital identity.

homes-in-mediterranean.title: Homes in Mediterranean
body: We developed a comprehensive real estate platform for Homes in Mediterranean, presenting property opportunities across the Mediterranean region to international investors. We built a rich content structure with property details, area guides, and investment information.
Multi-language support, advanced search and filtering features, and SEO optimization helped us target a global customer base.

sosyal-piton.title: Sosyal Piton
sosyal-piton.summary: Social media management agency portfolio website.
body: We developed a creative agency website for Sosyal Piton showcasing their social media management and digital marketing services. A portfolio, service details, and client testimonials established a strong brand image.
Dynamic design, animations, and visually driven content brought the agency's creative identity into the digital space. SEO and performance optimization increased organic reach.

kibris-lefkosa-taksi.title: Kıbrıs Lefkoşa Taksi
kibris-lefkosa-taksi.summary: Taxi booking and transportation service website in Nicosia.
body: We developed a professional website for Kıbrıs Lefkoşa Taksi offering online taxi booking, route calculation, and fare information. WhatsApp and phone integration enabled quick communication.
Local SEO optimization achieved top rankings for searches like 'Nicosia taxi' and 'Cyprus taxi.' A mobile-first design provided easy access for users on the go.

aydin-transfer.title: Aydın Transfer
aydin-transfer.summary: Airport transfer and VIP transportation service website.
body: We developed a professional website for Aydın Transfer offering airport transfer and intercity transportation services. Online booking, route information, and fare calculation put the user experience first.
Local SEO optimization, WhatsApp integration, and a mobile-first design boosted client acquisition.

kardesler-taxi.title: Kardeşler Taxi
kardesler-taxi.summary: Taxi service website with online booking and route info.
body: We developed a modern website for Kardeşler Taxi offering online taxi booking, fare information, and route calculation. Quick-contact buttons and WhatsApp integration enabled instant communication.
Local SEO efforts targeted top rankings in taxi-related searches. A mobile-friendly design provided easy access for users on the move.

sammys-hotel.title: Sammys Hotel
sammys-hotel.summary: Boutique hotel website with a custom-coded reservation system.
body: For Sammys Hotel we built a custom-coded reservation system tailored to the hotel's workflow instead of an off-the-shelf plugin — room selection, dates and request flow integrated into the brand-specific design.
A photo gallery, multi-language structure and SEO delivered an elegant digital storefront reaching international tourists. One of the strongest proofs of our custom-feature development.

all-pro-cyprus.title: All Pro Cyprus
all-pro-cyprus.summary: Multi-service company website in North Cyprus.
body: We developed a professional corporate website for All Pro Cyprus covering multiple service areas. Service details, references, and contact information established a strong digital presence.
Modern design, SEO optimization, and a mobile-friendly structure streamlined client acquisition. Multi-language support enabled the company to reach both local and international customers.

alert-muhendislik.title: Alert Mühendislik
alert-muhendislik.summary: Engineering and construction company corporate website.
body: We designed a corporate website for Alert Mühendislik showcasing engineering and construction services. We built a strong digital identity with a project portfolio, service details, and contact information.
Responsive design, fast load times, and SEO optimization made it easy for potential clients to reach out.

beton-store.title: Beton Store
body: We built an e-commerce platform for Beton Store selling construction materials and concrete products. We created a comprehensive digital store with a product catalog, order management, and contact system.
Modern design and a user-friendly interface put the customer experience first. SEO optimization drove organic traffic growth.

virginia-ice-cream.title: Virginia Ice Cream
virginia-ice-cream.summary: Premium ice cream brand website with menu and locations.
body: We designed a stylish, colorful website building the digital identity for Virginia Ice Cream's premium brand. We put the customer experience first with a menu, flavor catalog, and store locations.
Visual design, animations, and a responsive build reflecting the brand's energetic, playful personality brought a strong brand to the digital space.

welcome-pickups.title: Welcome Pickups
welcome-pickups.summary: Airport transfer and welcome service website.
body: We built a professional website for Welcome Pickups offering airport welcome and transfer services. We created a comprehensive platform with online booking, route information, and customer reviews.
A multi-language build for international customers, fast load times, and a mobile-friendly design delivered a strong digital presence.

mindloop.title: Mindloop
mindloop.summary: Personal 3D interactive website with immersive scroll-driven storytelling.
body: Mindloop is a personal project where I showcase my personal brand through a 3D, interactive experience. I built a dark-themed, atmospheric 3D hero scene with a narrative that deepens as the user scrolls.
Newsletter subscription, social media integration, and Home / How It Works / Philosophy / Use Cases pages deliver a content flow centered on technology and depth.

dental-health.title: Dental Health
dental-health.summary: Dental clinic website with service highlights and appointment booking.
body: We designed a clean, trust-building website for Dental Health showcasing the services of a West New York-based dental clinic. Highlights on advanced dentistry, quality equipment, and a friendly staff built a digital identity that earns patient trust.
A free consultation call-to-action, emergency contact information, and a responsive build made it easy to attract new patients.

securify.title: Securify
securify.summary: Data security SaaS landing page with bold typography and stats.
body: We designed a landing page for Securify, a data security and privacy-focused SaaS platform. A dark theme, bold typography, and compelling stats (1.5B+ GB protected, 65K+ startup users) built a trust-driven brand narrative.
A modern navigation structure spanning platform, solutions, company, and support pages clearly positioned the SaaS product.

lider-emlak.title: Lider Emlak
lider-emlak.summary: Listing and corporate website for a Bozüyük-based real estate agency.
body: We built a real estate website for Lider Emlak to professionally showcase its Bozüyük portfolio, with categorized, browsable listings on a custom WordPress theme matching the brand.
Listing management, location details and contact flows are handled from a single panel. On-page technical SEO delivered visibility in local searches. Delivered in partnership with Saiber.

odeme-takip-botu.title: Payment Tracker Bot
odeme-takip-botu.summary: Payment-tracking web app that sends automatic Telegram reminders as due dates approach.
body: We built a web app that monitors company payments (installments, cheques, cash and more) and sends automatic Telegram reminders as due dates approach — on a lightweight, reliable Node.js, Express and SQLite stack.

Auto-generated installment schedules, dashboards for overdue and next-7-days payments, and financial-integrity safeguards for settled records make it a concrete example of automating business workflows.

deprem-erken-uyari.title: Earthquake Early Warning
deprem-erken-uyari.summary: Early-warning simulation detecting P-waves from seismic data with a 1D CNN — R&D project.
body: We built a deep-learning project that simulates an earthquake early-warning scenario by detecting P-waves in seismic time-series data. The 1D CNN architecture in Python performs fast, accurate wave detection from raw signals.
As an R&D project it covers the full pipeline — data preparation, model training and evaluation — and stands as concrete proof of our time-series deep-learning capability.

arac-takip-yolo.title: Vehicle Tracking System
arac-takip-yolo.summary: Multi-vehicle detection and tracking in video — YOLOv11 + ByteTrack, fine-tuned on our own data.
body: We developed a computer-vision system that detects and tracks multiple vehicles in a video stream in real time. We fine-tuned Ultralytics YOLO11 on our own dataset and paired it with ByteTrack for identity-preserving tracking.
Adaptable to traffic analytics, security and smart-city scenarios, this R&D project showcases object detection, tracking and model-tuning capabilities together.

trafik-levha-okuma.title: Traffic Sign Recognition
trafik-levha-okuma.summary: Two-stage pipeline: YOLO detects traffic signs, a CNN classifies them — R&D project.
body: We built a two-stage computer-vision pipeline that first detects traffic signs with YOLO, then classifies the cropped regions with a CNN.
A potential foundation for driver-assistance and map-updating scenarios, this R&D work demonstrates our experience combining detection and classification models in a single production line.

yuz-duygu-analizi.title: Facial Emotion Analysis
yuz-duygu-analizi.summary: Real-time, explainable emotion estimation from 468 MediaPipe Face Mesh landmarks.
body: We built a system that estimates emotions in real time from the 468 facial landmarks extracted by MediaPipe Face Mesh. Instead of a black box we chose a rule-based, explainable approach — every prediction's reasoning is traceable.
Running live on a webcam, this R&D project is a practical computer-vision example that can underpin UX research and interactive applications.

hava-goruntu-segmentasyonu.title: Aerial Image Segmentation
hava-goruntu-segmentasyonu.summary: Six-class semantic segmentation of satellite imagery with U-Net — near-production R&D.
body: We developed a semantic-segmentation model that separates satellite imagery into six classes such as buildings, roads and vegetation, achieving high pixel-level accuracy with a U-Net architecture.
Structured close to production quality, this R&D project demonstrates geospatial data capability applicable to urban planning, agriculture and disaster analysis.

fuze-gudum-simulasyonu.title: Missile Guidance Visualization
fuze-gudum-simulasyonu.summary: Simulation and visualization of guidance algorithms in Python — R&D project.
body: We built a Python project that simulates guidance-algorithm behavior and visualizes it step by step; pursuit geometry and trajectory calculations can be followed through interactive plots.
Combining mathematical modeling with visualization, this R&D work exemplifies our ability to turn complex algorithms into understandable output.

contentflow-ai.title: ContentFlow AI
contentflow-ai.summary: AI-assisted content generation and workflow SaaS prototype built with Next.js.
body: ContentFlow AI is a SaaS product prototype that accelerates content production with AI. Built on Next.js, it gathers the journey from idea to draft to publishing flow in a single panel.
Developed as our own product idea, this prototype shows AI integration, SaaS architecture and productization experience in one place.

social-pro.title: Social Pro
social-pro.summary: Social media management SaaS prototype with scheduling and a unified dashboard.
body: Social Pro is a SaaS prototype aimed at managing multiple social accounts from one panel. Content planning, calendar and performance views were built on Next.js.
As our own product idea, it reflects experience in dashboard design, multi-account architecture and SaaS productization.

holly-trader.title: Holly Trader
holly-trader.summary: Trading and analysis tool prototype built on Node.js.
body: Holly Trader is a Node.js-based tool prototype that monitors market data and produces trading analyses. Data collection, signal generation and reporting flow through a single service.
This fintech product experiment is a side project demonstrating real-time data processing and automation capability.

ai-dating-app.title: AI Dating App
ai-dating-app.summary: AI-powered matching concept for a dating product, prototyped with Next.js.
body: We developed a dating-app concept that analyzes user profiles with AI and suggests compatibility-based matches. The Next.js prototype covers the profile flow, matching logic and recommendation screens.
Still at the product-idea stage, this work demonstrates our experience with AI-driven recommendation systems and modern product prototyping.

gemini-tracker.title: Gemini Tracker
gemini-tracker.summary: Gemini API-based tracking and monitoring tool prototype.
body: We built a tracking-tool prototype that monitors, summarizes and reports content and data streams using the Gemini API. LLM-based analysis turns raw data into meaningful digests.
This R&D tool is a practical example of combining large-language-model integration with automation scenarios.

fur-crm.title: FurCRM
fur-crm.summary: Advanced CRM for the furniture industry — accounts, invoicing, dealer management.
body: FurCRM is a comprehensive CRM and accounts-management system we built for furniture manufacturers. Product & variant management, customer CRM, accounts & finance, the quote–order–invoice flow and dealer management come together in a single panel.

With production tracking, reporting, staff and commission & performance modules it covers a furniture business's entire operation. Built as our own product, it is our most complete example of industry-specific SaaS productization.

lithos.title: Lithos
lithos.summary: Interactive geology education concept — explore the earth's layers with your cursor.
body: Lithos is an education-platform concept that teaches geology through an interactive experience. Around the theme 'Layers hold tales of time', we designed a hero experience where cursor movement peels back the layers of the bedrock.
Structured with course, field-guide and live-tour sections, this self-development project demonstrates our interactive storytelling and experimental interface design skills.

vanguard.title: Vanguard
vanguard.summary: Bold creative-agency landing concept — 'Design. Disrupt. Conquer.'
body: Vanguard is a bold landing-page concept designed around a creative-agency identity. Around the 'Design. Disrupt. Conquer.' slogan we used oversized typography, strong contrast and striking stat blocks (250+ brands, 95% client retention).
This self-development piece showcases brand-language building, typographic hierarchy and high-impact landing design.

jack-portfolio.title: Jack — 3D Creator
jack-portfolio.summary: 3D creator portfolio concept with scroll-driven text animations.
body: Jack is a portfolio-site concept designed for a 3D content creator. Letter-by-letter scroll-driven text animations, a project gallery and a pricing section build the personal-brand narrative.
This self-development piece shows our approach to animation choreography and personal-brand portfolio design.

veldara.title: Veldara
veldara.summary: Landing concept for a Svelte 5 + Three.js developer library.
body: Veldara is a landing page designed for a developer-library concept merging Svelte 5 with Three.js. Documentation, showcase and modules sections build a developer-first product story.
Focused on 3D web experiences, this self-development project demonstrates technical product marketing and developer-tool interface design.

manager-oto-servis.title: Manager
manager-oto-servis.summary: Multi-tenant SaaS CRM and pre-accounting platform for auto service businesses.
body: Manager is a multi-tenant SaaS platform we built for auto service and mechanic businesses. Vehicle flow, stock management, service sales, invoicing, account ledgers, staff management, reminders and reporting come together under one roof.

With a wildcard-subdomain architecture each business runs on its own domain. Targeting auto services in Northern Cyprus, this own product demonstrates horizontal SaaS architecture and multi-tenant system design.

emlak-sync.title: Emlak Sync
emlak-sync.summary: Multi-portal real estate listing sync panel — enter once, publish everywhere.
body: Emlak Sync is a multi-platform listing synchronization panel we built for real estate agencies. Listings are entered once and automatically published and kept in sync across Northern Cyprus property portals (HangiEv, 101evler).
Eliminating duplicate data entry, this own product demonstrates portal integrations, data synchronization and real-estate-specific automation.

sevgili-yogurt.title: Sevgili Yoğurt
sevgili-yogurt.summary: Mobile-first PWA for a dairy producer — stock, deliveries and account ledgers.
body: Sevgili Yoğurt is a stock + customer + delivery + account-ledger app we built for a dairy producer. With its mobile-first PWA structure the user picks a customer on the phone and logs delivered goods; stock decreases automatically and the amount is booked to the customer's ledger.
Streamlined for one-handed field use, it is a practical example of digitizing a small producer's daily operation.

dolmus-kontrol.title: Minibus Route Control
dolmus-kontrol.summary: Route-compliance automation: GPS Excel data becomes route control reports.
body: We built an automation system that checks whether a city's minibus (dolmuş) lines run on schedule. Excel data from a GPS tracking program is processed into per-line route control reports.
This Flask-based web app turns hours of manual checking into minutes — a field-proven example of data processing and process automation.

osyb-hap.title: ÖSYB Hap
osyb-hap.summary: Exam-prep platform with bite-size flashcards, a question bank and notes.
body: ÖSYB Hap is an exam-preparation platform we built for ÖSYB candidates. Bite-size flashcards, a question bank, note-taking and profile/progress tracking come together in a single app.
Built on Next.js as our own product, it demonstrates content organization and learning-experience design in the edtech space.

web-design.title: Web Design
web-design.desc: Brand-driven marketing sites with considered type, motion, and editorial rhythm.
web-design.longDesc: We design marketing sites that move with intention — every typographic choice, spacing decision, and motion detail serves the brand story. The result is a site that feels authored, not assembled. We work from strategy to final pixel, covering information architecture, interaction design, and handoff-ready component systems.

features.title: Brand-First Layout
features.desc: Every layout starts from the brand's visual language, not a template. Grid, type scale, and spacing are derived from the identity.

features.title: Editorial Typography
features.desc: Type is treated as the primary design element — scale, rhythm, and hierarchy are set before color or imagery.

features.title: Motion Design
features.desc: Purposeful animation that enhances storytelling without distracting. Entrances, transitions, and micro-interactions are storyboarded.

features.title: Design Systems
features.desc: Component libraries with documented tokens, variants, and usage guidelines — so your team can extend the design without breaking it.

features.title: Responsive First
features.desc: Every breakpoint is designed, not just resized. Mobile is a first-class experience, not an afterthought.

features.title: CMS Integration
features.desc: Contentful, Sanity, or headless setups that let non-technical editors publish at pace without touching code.

process.title: Discovery
process.desc: Brand audit, competitor analysis, stakeholder interviews. We establish what the site needs to say and who it needs to say it to.

process.title: Architecture
process.desc: Sitemap, content model, and page wireframes. Structure before style.

process.title: Visual Direction
process.desc: Two visual directions explored, one developed. Type, color, and layout language defined.

process.title: Design Build
process.desc: Full-fidelity Figma components across all breakpoints, with interaction specs and motion notes.

process.title: Handoff
process.desc: Developer-ready files, design tokens exported, component annotations, and a recorded walkthrough.

faq.q: Do you build the site or just design it?
faq.a: Both. We offer design-only engagements for teams with developers, and full design-to-code delivery. Most clients take the full package.

faq.q: What if we already have a brand?
faq.a: We work with existing brand systems and extend them into digital. We'll audit what you have and adapt rather than override.

faq.q: How many revision rounds are included?
faq.a: Two rounds per major phase. Additional rounds are billed at our hourly rate. In practice, we rarely hit that limit because we align early.

faq.q: Can you work with our existing CMS?
faq.a: Yes — we've built on Webflow, Framer, WordPress, Contentful, Sanity, and custom Next.js setups. We'll recommend what fits your team's workflow.

web-app.title: Web App
web-app.desc: Full-stack product surfaces — dashboards, tools, internal systems that hold up at scale.
web-app.longDesc: We build product-grade web applications that handle real load, real users, and real complexity. From the data model to the dashboard UI, every layer is considered. We specialize in Next.js full-stack builds with authentication, billing, role-based access, and real-time features — shipped with observability from day one.

features.title: Full-Stack Architecture
features.desc: Next.js App Router with server components, API routes, and edge functions. TypeScript throughout, no compromises.

features.title: Auth & Roles
